---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect tokens, facelets, or library behavior
---

## What happened?

Describe the actual result and the result you expected.

## Reproduction

Include the cube size, relevant token, facelets, move sequence, or coordinate
state. Give the smallest example you can and the wrapper commands or Flix code
needed to reproduce it.

## Environment

Include your operating system, JDK version, and the relevant output from
`./flixw doctor` when the problem may depend on the wrapper or compiler.
Remove private paths or other sensitive information before posting logs.
